_readme.purpose: 本文件只存放界面文字，不含任何代码逻辑。程序通过 rpe_toolbox/i18n.py 读取本文件。
_readme.how_to_add_language: 复制本文件为同目录下的 <语言代码>.json（如 en-US.json），翻译各字段的值后，用环境变量 RPET_LANG=<语言代码> 启动即可。键名（key）请勿修改。
_readme.placeholders: 含 {name} 形式占位符的文字由程序填充，翻译时请保留占位符本身。
_readme.options_structure: options 下的每一项都是「内部键: 显示文字」，内部键决定程序行为、不可修改，显示文字可自由翻译。
_readme.functions_structure: functions maps a feature key to its texts: key is bound to program behavior and must not be changed; tab is the short label on the tab strip, name is the full name, desc is the one-line description shown on top. Tab order comes from each module's MOD_ORDER, not from the order of this array.

functions.name: Hold/event head-to-tail connect
functions.desc: Set the endTime of a hold note or event to the next distinct startTime (simultaneous notes share the next time; the last hold is skipped).

functions.name: Nonlinear event splitting
functions.desc: Split events by the given density, handling easing edges and bezier control points.

functions.name: Polar coordinate conversion
functions.desc: Treat the distance from the origin as r and the rotation angle as theta, then convert back to cartesian; rotation events are copied as-is.

functions.name: Event type conversion
functions.desc: Change the kind of events, including X/Y scaling options.

functions.name: Image to note art generator
functions.desc: Generate note art from an image (JPG/PNG supported).

functions.name: Time interval to yOffset
functions.desc: Turn note time intervals and scroll speed into yOffset.

functions.name: Reverse / time stretch
functions.desc: Stretch or compress note and event times by a ratio; a negative ratio reverses them.

functions.name: MIDI BPM change extraction
functions.desc: Extract the list of BPM changes from a MIDI file.

functions.name: Vertical chain pitch
functions.desc: Give each note a pitch and turn it into a vertical chain; the chain length of a hold is derived from BPM and pitch, so the chart plays a melody.

functions.name: Full-score cut & merge
functions.desc: Cut and merge a full score by range and export a pez file (calls the external RPE Event Cutter).

help.hold_notes_connect:
[What] Sets the endTime of a hold (or event) to the next distinct note/event startTime so that long notes / events connect head-to-tail (simultaneous notes share the next time; the last one is skipped).

[Options]
- Allow length shorten: default off = only lengthen, never shorten. When on, "next note startTime" is searched from this note's own startTime, so a hold may become shorter.
- Distinguish tracks: default off = process all notes in time order. When on, each track is handled separately (0->1, 1->4, 2->3); simultaneous notes share the next time, the last stays.

[Usage] Paste notes, press Convert, read the result from the output JSON.
help.nonlinear_split:
[What] Splits events by a given density, easing edges and bezier control points handled automatically.

[Options]
- Cut density / note interval (subdivisions): one segment per subdivision, larger = denser (e.g. 4 = one segment per 1/4 beat).

[Usage] Paste events, set the density, Convert.
help.polar_conversion:
[What] Uses the distance from the origin as r and the rotation angle as theta, then converts back to cartesian; rotation events are copied as-is. Good for circles and spirals.

[Options]
- Cut density / note interval (subdivisions): one point per subdivision, larger = smoother circle.

[Usage] Paste (X,Y) events, set the density, Convert.
help.event_type_convert:
[What] Changes the kind of events, including X/Y scaling.

[Options]
- Locked-track hold: none / 5k(normal events) / 7k(including scaling) - how a hold is written as events.
- Curved drag: none / X offset & scaling / Y offset & scaling - split offset & scaling into a series of drags.
- Note interval (subdivisions): only shown when curved drag is not "none"; controls the density.

[Usage] Paste events, pick options, Convert (choose the arrow to mirror one property into another).
help.image_to_notes:
[What] Generates note art from an image: one pixel becomes one note; fully transparent pixels are skipped.

[Options]
- Image path: the JPG/PNG to convert.
- Note type: tap / drag / flick / hold (used for the whole image).
- Color mode: tint / corrected tint / alpha-as-brightness. "Corrected tint" derives the color from the main colors of tap/drag/flick/hold (#0AC3FF #F0ED69 #FE4365 #9AE8FD) so that multiply blending matches the original hue (white becomes the brightest desaturated grey). "Alpha as brightness" hides the legacy tint label.
- Flip horizontal / flip vertical / rotation: adjust the orientation.
- Use original size: ignore the two fields below and use the image pixel count directly.
- x pixels / y pixels / lock aspect ratio: set the resulting rows and columns manually.
- Auto note width: computes (675*2/pixel count/175) so all notes fit evenly inside +/-675.
- Note width: default 175 (screen width 1350, 175 per note at scale 1.0).

[Usage] Pick an image, adjust, Convert.
help.time_interval_to_yoffset:
[What] Converts note time intervals plus scroll speed into yOffset (for 3D/depth effects).

[Options]
- BPM: keep it the same as the chart; used to convert time.
- Speed: larger value = larger yOffset for the same interval.
- Unify start time: when on, all notes start at the same time.

[Usage] Paste notes, set the speed, Convert.
help.reverse_data:
[What] Stretches or compresses note and event times by a ratio; a negative ratio also reverses them.

[Options]
- Stretch ratio: 2 doubles the length, 0.5 halves it, -1 reverses at the original speed.

[Usage] Paste JSON, set the ratio, Convert.
help.midi_bpm_extract:
[What] Extracts the list of BPM changes from a MIDI file.

[Options]
- MIDI path: pick a .mid file (or press "Pick MIDI").

[Usage] Pick a file, Convert; the output JSON lists each BPM with its start beat.
help.vertical_pitch:
[What] When the same sound is repeated at high frequency, the ear hears the repetition rate as a pitch. This tool turns one key into a vertical chain (same x, spread along the time axis); while playing, the chain triggers at the given rate so you hear that pitch - give each key a different pitch and the chart plays a melody.

[Options]
- BPM: keep it the same as the chart; used to convert beats to seconds.
- Fill note type: tap/drag/flick/hold/same as input (default) - the type of the generated notes.
- Preview: synthesizes the whole passage with a sawtooth wave and plays it; a playback progress line is drawn on the canvas.
- Refresh view: redraws the canvas from the current input JSON.

[Count rules]
- Unit note length = 1 / pitch frequency (to hear that pitch you must repeat at that interval); pitch 0 (single key) falls back to a 16th note (60/bpm/4).
- Hold: count = duration x frequency, derived from BPM and pitch, not editable by hand; the pieces connect head-to-tail.
- Glide (pitch A->B): the repetition rate changes linearly, total = duration x (fA+fB)/2 and each time is solved from the integral of f, so the chain gets denser or sparser.
- Other notes: the count is manual; the first note stays in place and the rest follow one unit apart.

[Usage] Left-click a note to set pitch; right-click a hold for its end pitch, others for count; 0 = single key. The editor is embedded in the canvas with the caret placed there; Enter or clicking elsewhere saves, Esc cancels.
- Canvas: earlier time at the bottom, later on top; horizontal axis is the x coordinate (+/-675, note width 175), the time grid is in beats with one spare beat above and below; mouse wheel scrolls time, Ctrl+wheel zooms time.

[Audio] The preview uses a sawtooth wave (richest harmonics, easiest to hear the pitch); glides are rendered with a linear pitch change.
help.score_cut_merge:
[What] Cuts and merges a full score by range and exports a pez file (currently calls the external RPE Event Cutter; will be rewritten in Python later).

[Options]
- Input (zip/pez/folder): the score to process.
- Output pez: where the result is saved.

[Usage] Pick input and output, Convert.
